result:
All investigations are complete. Here are the answers.

## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (re-presigns S3-backed attachment URLs before they expire) — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`; ticker at `runner.go:30`) — wired in `startBackgroundRunners`: constructed at `server/server.go:162`, primed synchronously via `RunOnce` at `server/server.go:163`, and run in a goroutine at `server/server.go:169`.

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (the HTTP POST executes at `webhook.go:152`, `safeClient.Do(req)`). Protection: a custom `safeDialContext` on the shared client's transport resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs at dial time — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`, backed by `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54` (plus write-time `ValidateURL` at `validate.go:62`).

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` — defines the shared cross-provider type `IdentityProviderUserInfo`; note there is no Go `interface` type, the "abstraction" is the shared package contract). Concrete implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`, the only protocol that ships).

**h04** — No. The MySQL `DB` is only constructed via `mysql.NewDB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`), whose sole non-test caller is the factory `NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:22`). Direct `&DB{}` literals appear only in tests (e.g. `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`).

**h05** — Explicit Go code (transactional DELETEs), not a DB rule. The `reaction` table has no foreign keys / `ON DELETE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:91-97`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:91-97`). `DeleteUser` removes them in-transaction: `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`DELETE ... WHERE creator_id = ?`, `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:102`, impl `:400`) and `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memos, `user_delete.go:96`, impl `:380`). Same in the postgres/mysql `user_delete.go`.

**h06** — Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`, dispatch `:157`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401`, `:513`), `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518`, `:562`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`, `:119`), plus `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`) and `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`). Convergence function: `webhook.PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` (all dispatch wrappers funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` in `memo_service_webhooks.go:48` before enqueuing).

**h07**
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (route registered `fileserver.go:124`)
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` (→ driver) — `store/user.go:158`
- `(*sqlite.DB).ListUsers` (SQL SELECT hydrating `AvatarURL`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`

**h08** — Two declarers, both named `Runner`:
- `*s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked? YES — `server/server.go:163` (and self-called in its `Run` loop, `runner.go:36`)
- `*memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? NO — no production caller (only the standalone func `RebuildMemoPayload` is used, at `memo_service.go:108`/`:447`)

**h09** — Count: 6 distinct `Close` declarations: `*SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `*Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `*Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), and `*DB` for sqlite (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), postgres (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), mysql (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`). Invoked by non-test server code: `Store.Close` (`server/server.go:146`), `SSEHub.Close` (`server/server.go:206`), `Cache.Close` (`store/store.go:74-76`), and the active driver's `DB.Close` via `s.driver.Close()` (`store/store.go:78`).

**h10** — `util.GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — approx fan-in ~7 (call sites include `server/auth/token.go:194`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:26` & `:135`, `attachment_service_storage.go:209`, `shortcut_service.go:154`, `user_service_access_tokens.go:84`, `sso_username.go:15`).

**h11** — 1st: `User` (~5–6 packages outside store: server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss). 2nd: `Memo` (~4 packages: server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload).

**h12** — `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT at `memo.go:41`). Determination: the default driver is `sqlite`, set at `cmd/memos/main.go:122` (`viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`) and the `--driver` flag default (`:130`); the factory `NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:18`) switches on `profile.Driver`, so with no flags it dispatches to `sqlite.NewDB` and thus `sqlite.CreateMemo`.

**h13** — Impl: the unexported `service` struct implementing the `markdown.Service` interface (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`; interface at `markdown.go:31`), wrapping goldmark plus `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` for md-to-md. Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` (`markdown.go:85`), called at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`. Holders (fields typed as the interface): `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), and `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`).

**h14** — Computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`) → `MarkdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` on content change (`memo_service.go:447`), and the batch backfill `Runner.RunOnce` (`memopayload/runner.go:52`). Extracted properties (into `memo.Payload`): `Tags` and `Mentions` (`markdown.go:377,380`), `Property.Title` from a leading H1 (`:384`), `HasLink` (`:393`), `HasCode` (`:396`), `HasTaskList`/`HasIncompleteTasks` (`:399-405`).

**h15**
- API v1 GetMemo — `checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68`
- API v1 ListMemos — visibility filter injection — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- RSS router — restricts to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Fileserver attachment serving — `checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:649-700`
- Fileserver avatar serving — private-instance auth gate — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:173-181`

(MCP router adds no independent check; it delegates to the API v1 methods via `server/router/mcp/catalog.go:12,14`.)

**r01** — Premise is false: there is no Redis. The cache layer is a self-contained in-memory cache using only the standard library (`sync.Map`) at `store/cache/cache.go`. There is no per-user TTL — a single `DefaultTTL` of 10 minutes applies to all entries (`cache.go:59`), overridable per-entry via `SetWithTTL` (`cache.go:98`); cleanup sweeps every 5 minutes (`cache.go:60`). Three instances are created at `store/store.go:51-53`.

**r02** — Premise is false: no per-user (or any) API rate-limiting middleware exists. The Connect interceptor chain (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`) registers only `MetadataInterceptor` (`:22`), `LoggingInterceptor` (`:98`), `RecoveryInterceptor` (`:165`), and `AuthInterceptor` (`:208`). The only mention of rate limiting is a future-idea comment in `internal/email/doc.go:86` — no implementation, no limits.

**r03** — Premise is false: no nightly database-cleanup cron job exists (no cron-scheduled cleanup, no VACUUM/retention/purge job anywhere). A full cron scheduler package exists at `internal/scheduler/` but is dead code — it has zero importers outside its own tests. The only real scheduled work is the interval-based (not cron) `s3presign` runner on a 12-hour ticker (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`).

**r04** — Premise is false: no message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ, nor Kafka/Redis) is used. Webhook delivery is in-process via an asynchronous bounded goroutine queue: `asyncPostQueue`, a buffered channel of capacity 128 (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` (`webhook.go:42-55`) that call `Post`; producers enqueue via `PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`), dropping with a warning on overflow.

**r05** — Premise is false: there is no GraphQL anywhere (no schema, resolvers, or gqlgen/graphql dependency). The actual API surface is Protobuf-defined gRPC services with Connect + grpc-gateway REST/JSON transcoding: `.proto` definitions in `proto/api/v1/`, deps `connectrpc.com/connect`, `google.golang.org/grpc`, `grpc-gateway/v2` in `go.mod`, handlers in `server/router/api/v1/`, plus auxiliary RSS, MCP, and fileserver routers.
